questions.prompt: 把角画在标准位置：(a)$60^\circ$；(b)$135^\circ$；(c)$-240^\circ$；(d)$405^\circ$。

steps.title: (a) 画有向角
steps.body: 从正$x$轴逆时针旋转$60^\circ$。$60=0\cdot360+60$，终边位于第I象限，与$60^\circ$同终边。

steps.title: (b) 画有向角
steps.body: 从正$x$轴逆时针旋转$135^\circ$。$135=0\cdot360+135$，终边位于第II象限，与$135^\circ$同终边。

steps.title: (c) 画有向角
steps.body: 从正$x$轴顺时针旋转$240^\circ$。$-240=-1\cdot360+120$，终边位于第II象限，与$120^\circ$同终边。

steps.title: (d) 画有向角
steps.body: 从正$x$轴逆时针旋转$405^\circ$。$405=1\cdot360+45$，终边位于第I象限，与$45^\circ$同终边。

questions.answer: (a) 终边$60^\circ$，第I象限；(b) 终边$135^\circ$，第II象限；(c) 终边$120^\circ$，第II象限；(d) 终边$45^\circ$，第I象限

en.prompt: Draw each angle in standard position: (a)$60^\circ$; (b)$135^\circ$; (c)$-240^\circ$; (d)$405^\circ$.

steps.title: (a) Draw the directed angle
steps.body: Rotate counterclockwise by $60^\circ$ from the positive $x$-axis. Since $60=0\cdot360+60$, the terminal ray is in Quadrant I, coterminal with $60^\circ$.

steps.title: (b) Draw the directed angle
steps.body: Rotate counterclockwise by $135^\circ$ from the positive $x$-axis. Since $135=0\cdot360+135$, the terminal ray is in Quadrant II, coterminal with $135^\circ$.

steps.title: (c) Draw the directed angle
steps.body: Rotate clockwise by $240^\circ$ from the positive $x$-axis. Since $-240=-1\cdot360+120$, the terminal ray is in Quadrant II, coterminal with $120^\circ$.

steps.title: (d) Draw the directed angle
steps.body: Rotate counterclockwise by $405^\circ$ from the positive $x$-axis. Since $405=1\cdot360+45$, the terminal ray is in Quadrant I, coterminal with $45^\circ$.

en.answer: (a) Terminal ray $60^\circ$, Quadrant I; (b) Terminal ray $135^\circ$, Quadrant II; (c) Terminal ray $120^\circ$, Quadrant II; (d) Terminal ray $45^\circ$, Quadrant I

steps.body: From $s=r\theta$, the new angle is $\alpha=(\pi r/2-s)/r=\pi/2-s/r=\pi/2-\theta$.

steps.title: 由影长得角度
steps.body: 杆高$h$、影长$L$构成直角三角形，可量得光线与杆夹角$\theta$（等价于$\tan\theta=L/h$）。本题为$7^\circ12\prime=7.2^\circ$。

steps.title: 利用平行光线
steps.body: 竖直方向沿地球半径，平行光线使两城市间圆心角等于$7.2^\circ$。故500英里占全周$7.2/360=1/50$。

en.prompt: Eratosthenes knew Syene was about 500 miles due south of Alexandria. At noon on the summer solstice a vertical rod cast no shadow in Syene, but sunlight made angle $7^\circ12\prime$ with a vertical rod in Alexandria; sunlight rays were effectively parallel. Explain how measuring the Alexandria shadow estimates Earth circumference.

steps.title: Determine the angle from the shadow
steps.body: A rod of height $h$ and shadow length $L$ forms a right triangle that determines the sunlight angle $\theta$ (equivalently $\tan\theta=L/h$). Here $7^\circ12\prime=7.2^\circ$.

steps.title: Use parallel sunlight
steps.body: Local vertical directions follow Earth radii. Parallel sunlight makes the central angle between the cities $7.2^\circ$. Thus 500 miles is $7.2/360=1/50$ of the circumference.
